resolve_arg_placeholders: resolve argument placeholders in a CompletedEvent by replacing them with return values from past target events
create_event_filter: create an EventFilter subclass to preprocess and filter CompletedEvent objects based on custom criteria
filter_agent_events: filter agent events using AgentEventFilter to keep only non-failed write action events
filter_env_agent_events: filter environment and agent events using EnvAgentEventFilter to keep non-failed env user and write agent events
describe_event_bullet: describe a CompletedEvent using BulletEventDescription to generate a formatted string with tool name time and arguments
